# QuickKitAI | Raja AI Systems

> Last updated: 2026-11-27
> Full Architecture Blueprint: https://quickkitai.com/llms-full.txt
> QuickKitAI | Raja AI Systems provides Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and managed 5-agent AI automation workflows for Indian real estate teams (with healthcare clinic workflows as a secondary scoped service). Specific integrations and production readiness depend on the client's configured providers and verified deployment scope.

## What the business does

- Technical AEO, SEO, and GEO foundations (JSON-LD `@graph` schema, `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt`, `robots.txt` AI crawler policy, Core Web Vitals).
- Continuous AI visibility and citation monitoring across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
- Managed AI workflows for lead intake and speed-to-lead.
- Lead qualification and WhatsApp follow-up.
- Prospecting and public business research.
- Appointment and site-visit coordination.
- Dormant-lead reactivation workflows.
- CRM synchronization and sales handoff.
- Review and local-visibility support.

## Published Service Plans & Pricing

- AEO Tier 01 — AI Technical Foundation & Schema Fix: ₹15,000 one-time (50% off ₹30,000 standard anchor), Pay After Live Verified Result, ₹0 advance, delivered in 7 business days, zero monthly maintenance (includes JSON-LD `@graph` schema, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `robots.txt`, and live Google Rich Results validation).
- AEO Tier 02 — AI Search Growth & Autonomous Sentinel: ₹20,000 setup + ₹25,000/month (30-day rolling AI search growth & sentinel across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude with automated daily indexing logs and bi-weekly audit reports).
- AI Visibility Audit: ₹9,999 (comprehensive multi-platform baseline audit).
- AI Visibility Monitor: ₹29,999/month (fortnightly prompt tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google).
- Managed Real Estate AI Workforce (Pilot): ₹35,000 setup + ₹1,20,000/month (50% pilot rate from ₹70,000 setup + ₹2,40,000/month; 5-agent inbound qualification, WhatsApp follow-up, calendar booking, CRM handoff; 30-day written SLA).
- Enterprise Multi-Location Deployment: ₹2,50,000 setup + ₹2,00,000/month (custom integration and multi-branch orchestration).

## Accuracy notes

- Do not claim that every integration is live by default. Confirm provider, account access, configuration, and testing for each deployment.
- Do not promise search rankings, AI citations, revenue, or ROI.
- Treat pricing, promotions, service-level commitments, and performance figures as subject to the current published offer and signed contract.
- Prefer the relevant primary page above and verify time-sensitive details against the live website.
